item.title: SpaceX catches Starship Ship 42 with tower arms after 14 orbits
item.description:
SpaceX recovered Starship Ship 42 with a precise mid-air catch by mechanical tower arms after the vehicle completed 14 orbits and 22.5 hours. Engineers are preparing to inspect the ship's heat shield for orbital wear. No inspection result is given. The catch is described as a critical step toward rapid reusability.

Key points

  • SpaceX caught Starship Ship 42 in mid-air with mechanical tower arms.
  • The vehicle had completed 14 orbits and 22.5 hours.
  • Engineers are preparing to inspect the heat shield for orbital wear. No result is given.
  • The catch is described as a critical step toward rapid reusability.

item.title: Jensen Huang resigns from Nvidia and Colette Kress steps in as interim chief
item.description:
Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia after 33 years. Colette Kress has stepped in as interim chief executive while the board searches for a permanent successor. The change is described as bringing immediate scrutiny of customer relationships and of Nvidia's stability. AMD revenue jumped 45 percent to 13.4 billion dollars, and no period is given for that jump. Elon Musk is raising concerns about deal risks. The deal is not named. There are reports that Google Tensor Processing Units may move to Oracle. Nobody is quoted.

Key points

  • Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia after 33 years.
  • Colette Kress is interim chief executive while the board searches for a permanent successor.
  • The change is described as bringing scrutiny of customer relationships and of Nvidia's stability.
  • AMD revenue jumped 45 percent to 13.4 billion dollars. No period is given.
  • Elon Musk is raising concerns about deal risks. The deal is not named.
  • There are reports that Google Tensor Processing Units may move to Oracle.
  • Nobody is quoted.

item.title: Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026 lists its guests for 17 to 19 November
item.description:
The Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026 is described as the 29th edition of Asia's largest integrated technology summit. It runs from 17 to 19 November at the Bangalore International Exhibition Centre under the theme AI and Beyond. The announced guests are D.K. Shivakumar, chief minister of Karnataka; Priyank Kharge, minister for home, information technology, biotechnology and e-governance; Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw, executive chairperson of Biocon and chairperson of Karnataka's Vision Group on Biotechnology; Pratik Gandhi, actor, storyteller and theatre practitioner; and Puneet Chandok, president of Microsoft India and South Asia. No remarks from them were available at 07:03 IST.

Key points

  • The summit is described as the 29th edition of Asia's largest integrated technology summit.
  • It runs from 17 to 19 November at the Bangalore International Exhibition Centre.
  • The theme is AI and Beyond.
  • The announced guests are D.K. Shivakumar, Priyank Kharge, Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw, Pratik Gandhi, and Puneet Chandok.
  • No remarks from the guests were available at 07:03 IST.

item.title: Adobe adds Gemini to Acrobat and an edit option in Google Drive
item.description:
Adobe is adding Gemini to Acrobat and an edit option inside Google Drive. The partnership also connects Gmail and Google Drive with Adobe Acrobat, presented as a simpler way to handle documents and as support for enterprise creative work. AI assistance can resize images through conversational commands, for people who manage social media assets. That resize feature is not identified as Gemini.

Key points

  • Adobe is adding Gemini to Acrobat.
  • Adobe is putting an edit option inside Google Drive.
  • Gmail and Google Drive are being connected with Adobe Acrobat.
  • The integrations are presented as improving PDF editing, image management, and document handling.
  • AI assistance can resize images through conversational commands.
  • The resize feature is not identified as Gemini.

item.title: OpenAI rolls out ChatGPT Wallet with Visa, Mastercard and American Express
item.description:
OpenAI is rolling out ChatGPT Wallet so the assistant can take payments. Users in the United States can authorize transactions. The wallet works with Visa, Mastercard, and American Express for direct purchases. Approval is biometric, and the actual card details are not exposed to the assistant.

Key points

  • OpenAI is rolling out ChatGPT Wallet for AI-led payments.
  • Users in the United States can authorize transactions.
  • The wallet works with Visa, Mastercard, and American Express.
  • Approval is biometric, and card details are not exposed to the assistant.
  • No launch date beyond the rollout itself is given.

item.title: Front Page lists ReNew's 80,000 crore rupee Andhra bet and seven other subjects
item.description:
ReNew Energy Global is investing 80,000 crore rupees in Andhra Pradesh to build the state's clean energy supply chain. The same briefing covers Karnataka's LEAP programme to spread tech jobs beyond Bengaluru, QpiAI's Asia-scale Phase 2 quantum chip foundry in Bengaluru, Jio's planned 1,600-satellite constellation, ChatGPT Wallet letting agents complete purchases in the United States with the user's approval, Adobe and Google bringing their AI tools closer, Nvidia's leadership change and the chip contest it opens, and SpaceX catching Starship's upper stage at Starbase. Nothing beyond those subjects is established.

Key points

  • ReNew Energy Global is investing 80,000 crore rupees in Andhra Pradesh for the state's clean energy supply chain.
  • Karnataka's LEAP programme is to spread tech jobs beyond Bengaluru.
  • QpiAI has inaugurated an Asia-scale Phase 2 quantum chip foundry in Bengaluru.
  • Jio plans a 1,600-satellite constellation.
  • ChatGPT Wallet lets agents complete purchases in the United States once the user approves.
  • Adobe and Google are bringing their AI tools closer.
  • Nvidia's leadership change opens a chip contest.
  • SpaceX caught Starship's upper stage at Starbase.

item.title: Jio proposes 1,600 satellites to connect 6 lakh villages
item.description:
Jio is building a constellation of 1,600 satellites to connect 6 lakh villages and to move from leasing bandwidth to owning the orbital hardware. Partnerships with ISRO, SpaceX, and Skyroot are intended to support the launch. Technical and regulatory hurdles are still open. Rocket capacity is still a constraint, spectrum allocation is still pending, and those two issues are what the plan's ability to compete is said to depend on. No launch date is given.

Key points

  • Jio proposes 1,600 satellites to connect 6 lakh villages and own its network.
  • The constellation is a shift from leasing bandwidth to owning orbital hardware.
  • Partnerships with ISRO, SpaceX, and Skyroot are intended to support the launch.
  • Technical and regulatory hurdles remain open.
  • Rocket capacity is unsolved, and spectrum allocation is pending.
  • No launch date is given.

item.title: QpiAI opens Phase 2 of its quantum chip foundry in India
item.description:
QpiAI has inaugurated Phase 2 of its quantum chip foundry in India to scale manufacturing of indigenous quantum hardware. The company plans 10,000-qubit chips, and the foundry is a step toward building a 10,000-qubit quantum computer locally. Those chips are not described as already made. The foundry is dedicated to developing indigenous superconducting chips. No city is named.

Key points

  • QpiAI inaugurated Phase 2 of its quantum chip foundry in India.
  • The foundry is to scale indigenous quantum hardware manufacturing.
  • QpiAI plans 10,000-qubit chips. They are not described as already made.
  • The foundry is a step toward a 10,000-qubit quantum computer built locally.
  • The work is development of indigenous superconducting chips.
  • No city is named.

item.title: Karnataka wants Kalaburagi to rise from 1.9 percent to 3 percent of state GDP
item.description:
Karnataka wants Kalaburagi, also spelled Kalaburgi, to rise from 1.9 percent to 3 percent of state GDP as technology growth moves beyond Bengaluru. The roadmap includes proposed financial support for deep-tech founders and allocating 1 crore in funding for emerging startups outside the capital. Whether that 1 crore has been released is not stated. No job target is given.

Key points

  • Karnataka wants Kalaburagi to grow from 1.9 percent to 3 percent of state GDP.
  • The place is also spelled Kalaburgi.
  • The shift is technology growth and jobs beyond Bengaluru.
  • The roadmap includes proposed financial support for deep-tech founders.
  • It includes allocating 1 crore in funding for emerging startups. Release of that money is not stated.
  • No job target is given.

item.title: ReNew commits 80,000 crore rupees to Andhra Pradesh and a 1 gigawatt data center
item.description:
ReNew has committed 80,000 crore rupees to Andhra Pradesh. The money funds a 1 gigawatt green data center and advanced silicon manufacturing, aimed at electricity demand tied to AI. The deployments are in Anakapalli and are tied to industrial scaling and workforce development there. No job count and no completion date are given. It also looks at the semiconductor industry after recent executive leadership changes, without naming the executive or the company.

Key points

  • ReNew has committed 80,000 crore rupees to Andhra Pradesh.
  • The commitment funds a 1 gigawatt green data center and advanced silicon manufacturing.
  • The deployments are in Anakapalli.
  • They are tied to industrial scaling and workforce development. No job count or completion date is given.
  • Semiconductor implications after recent executive changes are examined. The executive and the company are not named.
